title: John 12:26 "If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, there My servant will be also; if anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him."
paragraphs: John 12:26 "If anyone serves Me, he must follow Me; and where I am, there My servant will be also; if anyone serves Me, the Father will honor him."

Done Bible Study & Cellgroup at Weegol's Garden
Teaching these faithful men about  "the Good Samaritan" Luke 10: 25-38. For in their line of work they may encounter people that may need help, and they should do what God has commanded us to do... to Love our neighbor as we love ourselves.

i thank God for the people that has been a good samaritan to me and my ministry... my cousin Jeremiah Betia Calo for the continued support and letting me use his venue and his men to be part of the advancement of God's Kingdom, and to my Bro. Mayor Edward U. Chan for the continued support for my ministry.... may GOD continue to bless you both and continue to pour out blessings as you both continue to help other people.
